content.comment_body: To whomever this concerns, Please disregard if this topic already exists. I spent several hours attempting to get it working on Windows 7 using an older USB-serial cable. I still had the serial connector cable for the [product_name]. If you run Windows 7 in XP SP2 compatibility mode, the software generally works, but the program may freeze when you try to open or save files. This issue relates to a missing line in the application.ini file that configures Java. To resolve this, add the following line to your application.ini file: app.laf=javax.swing.plaf.metal.MetalLookAndFeel Now you can run [product_name] on Windows 7 directly—compatibility mode is no longer necessary.
Hello, I attempted to add the suggested line to application.ini but received an 'access denied' error. Assistance with this would be appreciated.

Hi, Search for the application.ini file in your user directory, for example: C:\Users\[user_name]\.LOGOComfort6.1\application.ini. If you cannot access the file, it's likely due to limited permissions; you may not be logged in as administrator. Update your account privileges or log in as administrator. Make sure you edit the application.ini file associated with the user account that installed [product_name]. You can right-click to edit or open it with a text editor. analysis.insight_summary: Users faced issues running [product_name] on Windows 7 due to program freezes when opening or saving files, especially when using XP SP2 compatibility mode. It was discovered that a missing configuration line in application.ini related to Java was the root cause. Adding this line improved stability, allowing the software to run reliably in Windows 7 without compatibility mode. Some users also required help gaining proper file access permissions, and there was disappointment that the official developer documentation did not address this fix.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to operate reliably on Windows 7, with dependable file save/open functions and clear instructions or fixes provided by the developer or in documentation.
